integrity: Jacobian and both equilibrium evaluations were independently reconstructed from the six printed right-hand sides. A source-specific exact-rational counterexample and the entire characteristic factorization were replayed by a standalone SymPy verifier. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the published six-compartment continuous-time ODE; no clinical inference or numerical implementation assessment.
The conclusion at the threshold value equals nonhyperbolicity only; no center-manifold result.
The dysplasia persistence limit is conditional on global solution existence, nonnegativity, and viral clearance.
Published original content was inspected through an openly licensed full-text transcription rather than a separately rendered article PDF.
title: Exact EBV invasion boundary and the absence of a dysplasia-free state in a nasopharyngeal carcinoma model
